title: GRSE Delivers 3 Frontline Warships Simultaneously to Indian Navy
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders delivers INS Dunagiri (2nd P17A frigate), INS Sanshodhak (4th Survey Vessel), and INS Agray (ASW Shallow Watercraft).

blocks.content: GRSE delivered 3 naval platforms simultaneously, taking its total warship construction tally to 118 (80 for the Indian Navy).
